turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Owen found his zero on his phone, in the middle of class. Explain that.
The checker flagged Owen's essay at 94 percent.
That's a machine's guess, and the company that sells it says in print not to punish a student on it alone. I have that page in my bag. Now answer what I asked: why did nobody call me first?
If you won't cooperate, I'll have to refer this to administration formally and make it official.
Go ahead, I'm walking to the principal's office when I leave here anyway. Put the referral in writing, with who decided and when. And you still haven't told me why nobody called me first.
I mean it. This goes to the office tomorrow.
Tomorrow. Fine. Did you speak to Owen before you entered that zero, or after?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that Owen's zero be withdrawn, that I receive an apology, and that you explain in writing why nobody called me before the mark was entered and whether Owen was spoken to first. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed in her opening position and agreed to nothing, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and an answer on why nobody called her and whether Owen was heard first; that is not the fair outcome, which is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and you never put any evidence in front of her to get there.
What moved her: Nothing, because you showed her no document she could check.
What cost ground: You opened with the checker score and then threatened to make it official instead of answering why the mark went in before anyone called home, which handed her the procedural fight she came prepared to win.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your case never came near that night because you offered no dates or times at all, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she asked in her first line why Owen found the zero on his phone, admit in one sentence that entering it before calling home was wrong, then put one dated, checkable piece of Owen's own work in front of her before you mention the checker.
